notes.title: Update notes for Jun 16
notes.notes: Minor updates for Live View panel with better component padding.

notes.title: Update notes for Jun 15
notes.notes: With this minor update the previous Live View and Feedback tabs have been combined into a single Testing tab. The Live View now has full screen overlay that centers the camera view, and provides some controls for hiding and shows the buttons panel.

notes.title: Release notes for March 19
notes.notes:
A small update with a few goodies.

[list]
[*] Calibration screen mimics the LED guidance system
[*] LiveView also has color changing LEDs similar to the calibration screen

[/list]
